description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from  22.04.2019 to 28.04.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It is a regulatory instrument that modifies how customs regulations are applied, falling squarely under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
